detail: The disclosure was made under Regulations 31(4) and 31(5) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, which require acquirers to file details when crossing specified shareholding thresholds (typically 25% or via concert-party aggregation). Cholamandalam Financial Holdings, the holding company structure, has made this filing to NSE, indicating a material change in equity stake or control intent in Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company Limited (the listed entity). The filing does not disclose the precise shareholding percentage or consideration, but the regulatory trigger indicates compliance with the mandatory disclosure regime.
